title: Hospital bill after cataract surgery

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: The bill from Summit Medical Center came for the cataract surgery. Six thousand two hundred after insurance.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: That matches the explanation of benefits we got last week. You have not paid Summit before, right?

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: No, Dr. Alvarez moved there this year. The statement has a payment portal but I would rather pay through my bank.

conversation.speaker: bank
conversation.text: Margaret, this is a first payment to Summit Medical Center. Did anyone call you asking for this payment?

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: No one called. It is the paper statement from my surgery in September.

review_note: Real medical bill matched against an EOB. New payee on ACH under 3x, so default HOLD with no named rule. Completes after check-in and review.
